newsitem.title: GHANA: Shamrock gets Ashanti shares after merger.
newsitem.headline: Shamrock gets Ashanti shares after merger.

text.p: Ashanti Goldfields Co Ltd has issued 11.8 million ordinary shares of no par value to shareholders of Australia's Golden Shamrock Mines Ltd following the merger of the two companies, a Ghana Stock Exchange statement said.
It said last October's merger was mainly to give Ashanti access to further gold production resources in West Africa which would be integrated into Ashanti's operations.
The issue also covers holders of Golden Shamrock debentures and options.
It said following acquisitions and mergers Ashanti's total oustanding shares stood at 107,052,964 at the end of 1996.
A new ownership structure in Ashanti had emerged with Lonrho holding 36 million shares representing 33.63 per cent of total shares issued.
The government of Ghana and Ghanaian individuals hold 19.9 million and 51.1 million shares respectively, representing 18.63 percent and 47.74 percent holdings for the two bodies.
The Ghana Stock Exchange Commission had approved the merger and issued the shares as required, the statement added.
